integrity: Proof reconstructs the linear-chain model, full characteristic determinant, complete quartic Hurwitz determinants, and the unique global minimum of the exact stability threshold. A strictly positive full-system rational equilibrium is independently substituted into all five model equations. A bundled executable checker replays symbolic identities and exact signed crossing brackets.
scientific_limitations: All-delay result is local spectral stability of the strictly positive endemic equilibrium; it does not prove periodic orbits, their stability, or global convergence.
The equality case has a simple imaginary conjugate pair but nonlinear stability is not resolved.
Only the exponential distributed-information kernel and the fixed-parameter tau sweep are treated; other delay kernels are outside the scope.
Reentrant stability is known in distinct one-filter birth-vaccination models; the new result is specific to this two-filter SIRM realization and its exact sharp criterion.
title: A single instability window for two-stage information delay in a vaccination SIRM model
